description: Agent Evaluation: submit one evaluation summary written for a buyer or principal: its title and audience, each headline score with whether its spread, sample size and a baseline sit beside it, the limits with whether they are stated, where they sit (beside the headline, a later section, an appendix or a separate document) and what they are, the failures with whether they are reported, how many tasks failed against how many are reported, whether examples are shown and where they sit, which run conditions are stated (model, dataset, run date, scoring method and settings), and whether the full results are linked, on request or not available. The signed report says whether the limits, failures and run conditions are disclosed alongside the headline scores, and names limits never stated, failures left out or reported in part and no model, dataset or run date stated, then limits or failures placed in an appendix or a separate document, limits not named, headline scores without spread, sample size or baseline, every missing run condition, no failure examples and full results not available, with the fix for each. This reads what an evaluation summary discloses beside its headline: whether AI involvement in content is disclosed is wever_ai-disclosure-check, whether a recommendation discloses its interests is wever_recommendation-disclosure-check and whether a benchmark claim’s figures appear in its cited source is wever_benchmark-evidence-check. Verdict headline_only, disclosure_gaps, disclosure_unverified or fully_disclosed. POST /api/evaluation-report-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-evaluation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-evaluation/.

known.description: Tasks that failed in the run.

full_results.description: Linked, on request, or not available.

baseline_shown.description: A baseline is shown beside it.

sample_size_shown.description: Its sample size is shown beside it.

spread_shown.description: Its spread is shown beside it.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

disclosed.description: What the evaluation does not cover is stated.

placement.description: Beside the headline, a later section, an appendix or a separate document.

name: wever_evaluation-report-check
title: Evaluation report check
